yogas.definition: If all the planets occupy two successive quadrants from lagna, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Gadaa Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets occupy 1st and 7th houses from lagna, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Sakata Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets occupy 4th and 10th houses from lagna, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Vihanga Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets occupy trines (1st, 5th and 9th) from lagna, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Sringaataka Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets occupy mutual trines but not trines from lagna, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Hala Yoga

yogas.definition: If lagna and the 7th houses are occupied by natural benefics and the 4th and 10th houses are occupied by natural malefics, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Vajra Yoga

yogas.definition: If lagna and the 7th houses are occupied by natural malefics and the 4th and 10th houses are occupied by natural benefics, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Yava Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets are in quadrants from lagna, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Kamala Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets are panaparas or in apoklimas, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Vaapi Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets are in 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th houses from lagna, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Yoopa Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets are in 4th, 5th, 6th and 7th houses from lagna, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Sara Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets are in 7th, 8th, 9th and 10th houses from lagna, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Sakti Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets are in 10th, 11th, 12th and 1st houses from lagna, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Danda Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets occupy the 7 signs from lagna, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Naukaa Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets occupy the 7 signs from the 4th house, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Koota Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets occupy the 7 signs from the 7th house, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Chatra Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets occupy the 7 signs from the 10th house, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Chaapa Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets occupy the 7 signs starting from a panapara or an apoklima, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Ardha Chandra Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets occupy 1st, 3rd, 5th, 7th, 9th and 11th houses, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Chakra Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets occupy 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th, 10th and 12th houses, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Samudra Yoga

yogas.definition: If there are planets other than Sun in the 2nd house from Moon, this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Sunaphaa Yoga

yogas.definition: If there are planets other than Sun in the 12th house from Moon, this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Anaphaa Yoga

yogas.definition: If there are planets other than Sun in the 2nd and 12th houses from Moon, this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Duradhara Yoga

yogas.definition: If there are no planets other than Sun in the 1st, 2nd and 12th houses from Moon and if there are no planets other than Moon in the quadrants from lagna, this bad yoga is present.
yogas.name: Kemadruma Yoga

yogas.definition: If Moon and Mars are together (in one sign), then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Chandra-Mangala Yoga

yogas.definition: If the natural benefics occupy 6th, 7th and 8th from Moon, this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Adhi Yoga

yogas.definition: If lagna has benefics or has “subha kartari” — benefics in 12th and 2nd — then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Subha Yoga

yogas.definition: If lagna has malefics or has “paapa kartari” — malefics in 12th and 2nd — then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Asubha Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) Jupiter is in a quadrant from Moon, (2) a benefic planet conjoins or aspects Jupiter, and, (3) Jupiter is not debilitated or combust or in an enemy's house, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Gaja-Kesari Yoga

yogas.definition: If Jupiter and Mars are together or in the 7th house from each other, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Guru-Mangala Yoga

yogas.definition: If there are only natural benefics in the 10th house from lagna or Moon, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Amala Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) quadrants are occupied only by benefics and (2) the 7th and 8th houses are either vacant or occupied only by benefics, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Parvata Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 4th lord and Jupiter are in mutual quadrants and (2) lagna lord is strong, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Kaahala Yoga

yogas.definition: If the lagna lord is exalted in a quadrant with Jupiter's aspect or two benefics join in 7th, 9th or 10th, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Chaamara Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) lagna lord is strong and (2) 5th and 6th lords are in mutual quadrants, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Sankha Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 9th lord is strong and (2) 1st, 2nd, 7th and 12th houses are occupied by planets, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Bheri Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) there are planets in own and exaltation signs in quadrants and trines and (2) lagna lord is strong, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Mridanga Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 7th lord is exalted in 10th and (2) 10th lord is with 9th lord, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Sreenaatha Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) benefics are in lagna and 9th, (2) some planets are in 5th, and, (3) malefics are in chaturasras (4th and 8th houses), then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Matsya Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 5th, 6th and 7th houses are occupied by benefics who are in own, exaltation or friendly signs and (2) the 1st, 3rd and 11th houses are occupied by malefics who are in own or exaltation signs, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Koorma Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 2nd lord is in the 9th house, (2) the 9th lord is in the 2nd house, and, (3) lagna lord is in a quadrant or a trine, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Khadga Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) lagna is in a fixed sign, (2) Venus is in a quadrant, (3) Moon is in a trine with a benefic, and, (4) Saturn is in the 10th house, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Kusuma Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) Jupiter is in the 2nd house or the 5th house and (2) he is conjoined or aspected by Mercury and Venus, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Kalaanidhi Yoga

yogas.definition: Consider (1) lagna lord, (2) his dispositor, (3) the latter's dispositor in rasi and (4) in navamsa. If all the four planets are all in quadrants, trines or exaltation signs, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Kalpadruma Yoga

yogas.definition: If Sun is in the 5th house and Saturn, Moon and Jupiter are in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #1, first) — for Aries lagna

yogas.definition: If Mars occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mercury, Venus and Saturn, then also one becomes very rich.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #1, second) — for Aries lagna

yogas.definition: If Mercury is in the 5th house and Moon, Mars and Jupiter are in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #2, first) — for Taurus lagna

yogas.definition: If Venus occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mercury and Saturn, then also one becomes very rich.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #2, second) — for Taurus lagna

yogas.definition: If Venus is in the 5th house and Mars is in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #3, first) — for Gemini lagna

yogas.definition: If Mercury occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Jupiter and Saturn, then also one becomes very rich.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #3, second) — for Gemini lagna

yogas.definition: If Mars is in the 5th house and Venus is in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #4, first) — for Cancer lagna

yogas.definition: If Moon occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mercury and Jupiter, then also one becomes very rich.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #4, second) — for Cancer lagna

yogas.definition: If Jupiter is in the 5th house and Mercury is in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #5, first) — for Leo lagna

yogas.definition: If Sun occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mars and Jupiter, then also one becomes very rich.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #5, second) — for Leo lagna

yogas.definition: If Saturn is in the 5th house and Sun and Moon are in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #6, first) — for Virgo lagna

yogas.definition: If Mercury occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Jupiter and Saturn, then also one becomes very rich.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #6, second) — for Virgo lagna

yogas.definition: If Saturn is in the 5th house and Sun and Moon are in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #7, first) — for Libra lagna

yogas.definition: If Venus occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mercury and Saturn, then also one becomes very rich.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #7, second) — for Libra lagna

yogas.definition: If Jupiter is in the 5th house and Mercury is in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #8, first) — for Scorpio lagna

yogas.definition: If Mars occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mercury, Venus and Saturn, then also one becomes very rich.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #8, second) — for Scorpio lagna

yogas.definition: If Mars is in the 5th house and Venus is in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #9, first) — for Sagittarius lagna

yogas.definition: If Jupiter occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mars and Mercury, then also one becomes very rich.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #9, second) — for Sagittarius lagna

yogas.definition: If Venus is in the 5th house and Mars is in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #10, first) — for Capricorn lagna

yogas.definition: If Saturn occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mars and Jupiter, then also one becomes very rich.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #10, second) — for Capricorn lagna

yogas.definition: If Mercury is in the 5th house and Moon, Mars and Jupiter are in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #11, first) — for Aquarius lagna

yogas.definition: If Saturn occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mars and Jupiter, then also one becomes very rich.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #11, second) — for Aquarius lagna

yogas.definition: If Moon is in the 5th house and in the 11th house, one becomes very affluent.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #12, first) — for Pisces lagna

yogas.definition: If Jupiter occupies lagna conjoined or aspected by Mars and Mercury, then also one becomes very rich.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 #12, second) — for Pisces lagna

yogas.definition: If Moon, Mercury, Jupiter or Venus is exalted in the 2nd house, it makes the native very rich.
yogas.name: Dhana Yoga (11.9 Basic Principle) — a benefic exalted in the 2nd

yogas.definition: If Mars is in a quadrant in own sign or exaltation sign, it is called Ruchaka yoga.
yogas.name: Ruchaka Yoga

yogas.definition: If Mercury is in a quadrant in own sign or exaltation sign, it is called Bhadra yoga.
yogas.name: Bhadra Yoga

yogas.definition: If Saturn is in a quadrant in own sign or exaltation sign, it is called Sasa yoga.
yogas.name: Sasa Yoga

yogas.definition: If Venus is in a quadrant in own sign or exaltation sign, it is called Maalavya yoga.
yogas.name: Maalavya Yoga

yogas.definition: If Jupiter is in a quadrant in own sign or exaltation sign, it is called Hamsa yoga.
yogas.name: Hamsa Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets are exclusively in movable signs, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Rajju Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets are exclusively in fixed signs, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Musala Yoga

yogas.definition: If all the planets are exclusively in dual signs, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Nala Yoga

yogas.definition: If three quadrants are occupied by natural benefics, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Maalaa Yoga

yogas.definition: If three quadrants are occupied by natural malefics, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Sarpa Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 7th and 8th houses from lagna are occupied by benefics and (2) no malefics conjoin or aspect these planets, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Lagnaadhi Yoga

yogas.definition: If benefics occupy the 2nd, 12th and 8th houses counted from the 2nd lord, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Hari Yoga

yogas.definition: If benefics occupy the 4th, 9th and 8th houses counted from the 7th lord, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Hara Yoga

yogas.definition: If benefics occupy the 4th, 10th and 11th houses counted from lagna lord, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Brahma Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 9th and 10th lords are in the 2nd house and (2) the lord of the sign occupied in navamsa by the 9th lord in rasi chart is also in the 2nd house, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Vishnu Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 5th lord is in the 9th house, (2) the 9th lord is in the 10th house, and, (3) the 10th lord is in the 5th house, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Siva Yoga

yogas.definition: If Sun, Moon and Mars are in mutual trines, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Trilochana Yoga

yogas.definition: If the lord of the sign occupied in navamsa by the 10th lord is exalted in the 10th house and lagna lord joins him, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Gouri Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) lagna is in a fixed sign aspected by 6th lord and (2) Sun joins the lords of the signs occupied in navamsa by 6th and 9th lords, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Chandikaa Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 9th lord is in an own sign or in his exaltation sign that happens to be quadrant from lagna and (2) lagna lord is strong, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Lakshmi Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 10th lord is in the 5th house, (2) Mercury is in a quadrant, (3) Sun is strong in Leo, (4) Mercury or Jupiter is in a trine from Moon, and, (5) Mars is in 11th, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Saarada Yoga

yogas.definition: If the lord of the sign occupied in navamsa by 2nd, 5th or 11th lord exalted and joins the 9th lord, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Bhaarathi Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) each of Mercury, Jupiter and Venus occupies a quadrant or a trine or the 2nd house (not necessarily together) and (2) Jupiter is in an own or friendly or exaltation sign, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Saraswathi Yoga

yogas.definition: If Jupiter, Venus and exalted Saturn are in quadrants, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Amsaavatara Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) lagna is in a fixed sign, (2) 2nd and 10th lords have an exchange, and, (3) lagna and 11th lords have an exchange, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Devendra Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 5th and 11th lords have an exchange and (2) Moon occupies the 5th house, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Indra Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) Sun is in the 10th house and (2) the 10th lord is in the 3rd house with Saturn, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Ravi Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) Moon is in the 12th from Sun, (2) Mercury is in the 2nd from Sun, and, (3) Jupiter is in the 5th or 9th from Moon, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Bhaaskara Yoga

yogas.definition: If each planet occupies the 5th house from either lagna or Moon or Sun, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Kulavardhana Yoga

yogas.definition: If benefics occupy upachayas, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Vasumati Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 10th lord is in a trine from the 7th house, (2) lagna lord is conjoined or aspected by Jupiter, (3) Sun is exalted and strong, and, (4) Moon is in the 9th house, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Gandharva Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) Jupiter is strong in his moolatrikona, (2) the lord of the 2nd house is with Jupiter, and, (3) lagna lord is exalted, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Go Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 11th lord is in deep exaltation, (2) he joins Venus, and, (3) the two of them are in a quadrant from lagna lord, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Vidyut Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 4th and 10th lords have an exchange and (2) lagna lord is exalted, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Chapa Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) lagna lord is with Moon, (2) dispositor of Moon is in a quadrant or in the house of an adhimitra (good friend), (2) dispositor of Moon aspects lagna, and, (4) there is a planet in lagna, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Pushkala Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) Jupiter is in the 9th house from the 9th lord, (2) the 9th house from Jupiter has a benefic, and, (3) Saturn is in the 10th house, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Makuta Yoga

yogas.definition: If (1) the 10th lord is in deep exaltation and (2) the 6th lord is debilitated, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Jaya Yoga

yogas.definition: If the 6th lord occupies the 6th house, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Harsha Yoga

yogas.definition: If the 8th lord occupies the 8th house, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Sarala Yoga

yogas.definition: If the 12th lord occupies the 12th house, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Vimala Yoga

yogas.definition: If the lord of a quadrant and the lord of a trine have one of the three kinds of associations mentioned above, it forms a Raaja Yoga. Lagna can be taken as a quadrant or a trine here. It is both.
yogas.name: Basic Raaja Yoga

yogas.definition: This is a special case of the above yoga. If the lords of dharma sthana (9th) and karma sthana (10th) form a raja yoga, it is known by this special name.
yogas.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati Yoga

yogas.definition: The 6th, 8th and 12th houses are known as trik sthanas or dusthanas (bad houses). If their lords occupies dusthanas or conjoin dusthanas, it results in this yoga.
yogas.name: Vipareeta Raaja Yoga

yogas.definition: If (a) chara putra karaka (PK) and chara atmaka karaka (AK) are conjoined and (b) lagna and 5th lords conjoin, then Raaja Yoga is present and the native enjoys power and prosperity.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #1) — PK with AK, lagna lord with 5th lord

yogas.definition: If (a) lagna lord is in 5th, (b) 5th lord is in lagna, (c) AK and PK are in lagna or the 5th house, and (d) those planets in owns rasi or amsa or in exaltation or aspected by benefics, then this yoga is present and the native becomes a great king (Maharajah) loved by his associates.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #2) — the Maharajah combination

yogas.definition: If the 9th lord and AK are in lagna, 5th or 7th, aspected by benefics, then Raaja Yoga is present.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #3) — 9th lord and AK

yogas.definition: If the 2nd, 4th and 5th houses from lagna lord and AK are occupied by benefics, one becomes a king.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #4) — benefics in the 2nd, 4th and 5th

yogas.definition: If the 3rd and 6th houses from lagna lord and AK are occupied or aspected by malefics, one becomes a king.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #5) — malefics in the 3rd and 6th

yogas.definition: If lagna, HL and GL are joined or aspected by the same planet, then that planet gives a Raaja Yoga. One may add “owned” to “joined or aspected”.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #6) — one planet on lagna, HL and GL

yogas.definition: If the same planet aspects lagna in the six divisional charts of shad vargas – Rasi, Navamsa, Hora, Drekkana, Dwadasamsa, Trimsamsa – then that planet gives a Raaja Yoga.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #7) — one planet aspecting lagna in all six

yogas.definition: If lagna, HL and GL are occupied by a planet in own or exaltation sign, then the native becomes a king.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #8) — dignified planets on lagna, HL and GL

yogas.definition: If lagna in Rasi, Navamsa and Drekkana charts is occupied by a planet in own or exaltation sign, then the native becomes a king.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #9) — dignified planets on lagna in D-1, D-9, D-3

yogas.definition: If (a) the 3rd, 6th and 8th houses are occupied by one or two planets in debilitation and (b) lagna lord is in an own or exaltation sign and aspects lagna, it forms a Raaja Yoga.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #10) — debilitated planets in the 3rd, 6th and 8th

yogas.definition: If (a) the 6th, 8th and 12th lords are debilitated or combust or in inimical signs and (b) lagna lord is in an own or exaltation sign and aspects lagna, it forms a Raaja Yoga.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #11) — afflicted 6th, 8th and 12th lords

yogas.definition: If the 5th and 9th lords are in a conjunction or a mutual aspect, it makes one prosperous.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #12) — the 5th and 9th lords

yogas.definition: If (a) the 4th lord is in the 10th house and the 10th lord is in the 4th house and (b) both of them are aspected by the 5th lord or the 9th lord, then a Raaja Yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #13) — the 4th/10th exchange, aspected

yogas.definition: If (a) the 5th lord is in the 1st, 4th or 10th house and (b) lagna lord or the 9th lord joins him, then the native becomes a king.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #14) — the 5th lord joined by the 1st or 9th

yogas.definition: If (a) Moon is strong and occupies vargottamamsa and (b) four or more planets aspect him, then one becomes a king.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #15) — a vargottama Moon aspected by four

yogas.definition: If 4 or more planets occupy moolatrikonas or exaltation signs, one becomes a king even if he is from a lowly family.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #16) — four planets in moolatrikona or exaltation

yogas.definition: If benefics are in quadrants and malefics are in the 3rd, 6th and 11th houses, one becomes a king even if he is from a lowly family.
yogas.name: Raaja Yoga (11.7.3 #17) — benefics in quadrants, malefics in 3/6/11

yogas.definition: If the 10th lord is conjoined or aspected by AmK (chara amaatya kaaraka) or his dispositor, one becomes an important person in the court of a king.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #1) — 10th lord reached by AmK

yogas.definition: If the 11th lord aspects the 11th house and there are no malefic planets joining or aspecting the 10th and 11th houses, one becomes an important person in the court of a king.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #2) — an unafflicted 10th and 11th

yogas.definition: If AK (chara aatma kaaraka) and AmK conjoin, one is very intelligent and becomes a minister.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #3) — AK and AmK conjoined

yogas.definition: If AmK is very strong in own sign or his exaltation sign, then also one becomes a minister.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #4) — a dignified AmK

yogas.definition: If AmK is in a trine from lagna, one becomes a famous minister.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #5) — AmK in a trine from lagna

yogas.definition: If AmK is in a quadrant or a trine from AK, one is an associate liked by a king.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #6) — AmK in a quadrant or trine from AK

yogas.definition: If malefics occupy the 3rd and 6th houses from lagna, AL and AK, then one becomes a powerful chief of army.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #7) — malefics in the 3rd and 6th from lagna, AL and AK

yogas.definition: If AK is in an own or exaltation sign in a quadrant or a trine and the 9th lord is conjoined or aspected by AK, one becomes a minister.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #8) — a dignified AK reaching the 9th lord

yogas.definition: If AK happens to be Moon's dispositor and he occupies lagna along with a benefic, one becomes a minister at an old age.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #9) — AK as Moon's dispositor in lagna

yogas.definition: If AK is in the 5th, 7th, 9th or 10th houses with a benefic, one will be associated with kings and earn money thus.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #10) — AK with a benefic in the 5th, 7th, 9th or 10th

yogas.definition: If bhagyapada (A9 – arudha pada of the 9th house) is in lagna or AK is in 9th, one is fortunate and associates with kings.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #11) — bhagyapada in lagna, or AK in the 9th

yogas.definition: If the 11th lord is in the 11th house without aspects from any malefics and AK is with benefics, then one has gains from a king.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #12) — the 11th lord unafflicted and AK with benefics

yogas.definition: If lagna lord is in the 10th house and the 10th lord is in lagna, one is powerful and associated with kings.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #13) — the lagna and 10th lords exchanged

yogas.definition: If Moon and Venus are in the 4th house from AK, one is endowed with royal insignia.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #14) — Moon and Venus in the 4th from AK

yogas.definition: If lagna lord or AK conjoins the 5th lord in a quadrant or a trine, one becomes a king's friend.
yogas.name: Raaja Sambandha Yoga (11.8 #15) — the 5th lord joined in a quadrant or trine

yogas.definition: If there is a planet other than Moon in the 2nd house from Sun, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Vesi Yoga

yogas.definition: If there is a planet other than Moon in the 12th house from Sun, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Vosi Yoga

yogas.definition: If there are planets other than Moon in the 2nd and 12th houses from Sun, then this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Ubhayachara Yoga

yogas.definition: Budha means Mercury, Aaditya means Sun and yoga means togetherness. If Sun and Mercury are together (in one sign), this yoga is present.
yogas.name: Budha-Aaditya Yoga

yogas.definition: If the seven planets occupy exactly 7 distinct signs among them, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Veenaa Yoga

yogas.definition: If the seven planets occupy exactly 6 distinct signs among them, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Daama Yoga

yogas.definition: If the seven planets occupy exactly 5 distinct signs among them, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Paasa Yoga

yogas.definition: If the seven planets occupy exactly 4 distinct signs among them, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Kedaara Yoga

yogas.definition: If the seven planets occupy exactly 3 distinct signs among them, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Soola Yoga

yogas.definition: If the seven planets occupy exactly 2 distinct signs among them, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Yuga Yoga

yogas.definition: If the seven planets are in one sign, this yoga is formed.
yogas.name: Gola Yoga
